treasure_rules.rule: Any encounter may yield treasure, wandering or lair, because swallowed treasure is found in the creature's belly.

steps.step: Creature takes 2d6 damage per round inside the belly until it dies or the sturgeon is killed.
Each round, creature must save versus Paralysis or be paralyzed.
If armed with a sharp weapon and not paralyzed, creature may attack from inside at -4 versus effective AC 2.
If the swallowed creature dies and remains in the belly for 6 turns, it is irrecoverably digested.

confidence_notes.note: The printed stat block is OCR-corrupted. I reconstructed AC 1, HD 30*, damage 1d6x10, morale +2, and treasure R,N from the flattened line, but confidence is below 0.90.

The earth elemental size text is truncated in the source. I retained only the explicit surviving rule that height is 1' per Hit Die; any omitted dimension detail could not be recovered with high confidence.

Stone, frost, cloud, and storm giant stat lines are flattened into prose after the ghoul entry. I reconstructed the variant stat blocks from that sequence, but confidence is below 0.90 on formatting-dependent fields.
The goblin stat block is OCR-flattened. I reconstructed the standard fields from the surviving sequence, but confidence is below 0.90 on the printed-line restoration.
